candidates.description: This vector represents Thai words indicating quantity, amount, or distribution.
This feature vector represents common Thai vowel characters, tone marks, and sub-syllabic consonant-vowel clusters used in Thai script tokenization.
The feature vector represents the Thai consonant letter "ก" (ko kai) combined with various Thai vowel and tone mark diacritics.
This feature vector activates strongly in contexts related to surfing, coastal culture, and ocean wave sports.
This feature activates on words and word fragments related to water sports and watercraft.
This feature vector activates common words and subwords across multiple languages, including Thai and German.
These tokens represent noisy fragments of Thai script and multilingual text encoding artifacts.
This feature vector activates on a mixed set of multilingual subword tokens and fragments spanning various writing systems.
This feature vector represents the concepts of the Olympic Games and sports competitions, particularly with strong associations to Thailand and the International Olympic Committee.
This vector represents common adjectives and relational directional words used in English phrasing.
